key.name: settings-version
key.description: Bumped after migrations have run; used to keep migrations idempotent

key.name: gitlab-url
key.description: The complete URL of your GitLab server, including the protocol (e.g., https://gitlab.com). HTTPS is recommended.

key.name: gitlab-token
key.description: Personal access token used only when libsecret is unavailable; emptied once the token is stored in the keyring

key.name: tracked-projects
key.description: JSON array of projects whose issues appear in the Doing queue and in search

key.name: doing-labels
key.description: Comma-separated labels identifying the Doing column. The queue shows open issues assigned to the current user in the tracked projects.

key.name: lock-behaviour
key.summary: Timer behaviour when the screen locks
key.description: One of pause, keep-counting or resume-on-unlock

key.name: show-panel-time
key.summary: Show elapsed time in the top bar
key.description: Show the elapsed time of the active session next to the indicator icon

key.name: timer-state
key.description: Versioned JSON containing all issue sessions, preserved across lock, logout and restart

key.name: queue-cache
key.description: JSON object with the last known Doing queue so the menu renders without waiting for the network

key.name: cached-user
key.description: JSON object with the authenticated user for offline start

key.name: projects-cache
key.description: JSON object containing the cached GitLab project list

key.name: report-tags-filter
key.description: Comma-separated list of tags or regex patterns to filter in reports (e.g., "Maintenance corrective,^Maintenance.*$"). Leave empty to show all tags.

key.name: report-view
key.description: Either categories or calendar

key.name: report-user
key.description: Username filter in the report window; empty means everyone

key.name: report-export-format
key.description: Either csv or md

key.name: toggle-timer-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to pause or resume the timer, or open the menu when nothing is tracked

key.name: stop-send-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to submit the active session's time to GitLab

key.name: cancel-timer-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to discard the active session (undo is offered)

key.name: select-issue-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the menu with the search entry focused

key.name: monthly-report-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the monthly report window

key.name: default-project
key.description: Migrated into tracked-projects

key.name: resume-on-unlock
key.summary: Resume timer when screen is unlocked (legacy)
key.description: Migrated into lock-behaviour

key.name: count-time-when-locked
key.description: Migrated into lock-behaviour
